description: Read one principal's current Play Console permissions by email — read-only, nothing changes. Works for a human teammate or a service account (…@….iam.gserviceaccount.com); both are the same user row keyed by email. Returns account-level permissions and, per app, the exact permission values already held. This is the prerequisite before grant_app_permission: an append has to preserve every app the principal already reaches, so read the current grants first and confirm them with the user.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account (the one acting). Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

target_user_email.description: The email whose permissions to read — e.g. the CI service account …@….iam.gserviceaccount.com.

name: get_user_permissions
